verdicts.reason: B splits inline parsing into small `tryCode`/`tryLink`/`tryBold`/`tryItalic` helpers that share one `{html, next}` return shape, so each rule can be read and changed on its own, whereas A packs every rule into one long branching loop with scattered `continue`s.

Version A splits inline parsing into small named helpers (tryCode, tryLink, tryBold, tryItalic) dispatched by matchAt, while Version B packs every construct into one long branchy loop with scattered `continue`s and fall-throughs, which makes A easier to read and safer to change.
